name: 33414 · Wellington, FL
findings: ZIP 33414 (Wellington) has 242 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33414 (Wellington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
